newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamanouchi markets dysuria drug in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Yamanouchi markets dysuria drug in Philippines.

text.p: Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it has begun marketing Harnal, a therapeutic agent for dysuria, in the Philippines through a local subsidiary.
The drug is being marketed by Yamanouchi Philippines Inc, which was set up in April as Yamanouchi's first Asian subsidiary.
The unit is jointly marketing the drug with Zuelling Pharma Corp, the largest medical marketing firm in the Philippines, Yamanouchi said in a statement.
The major Japanese drug maker plans to sell its drugs directly to Indonesia and Thailand as early as 1998.
Dysuria is a condition characterised by difficult or painful discharge of urine.
